purpose: Separate display cadence from computation and committed disk throughput; no physical-camera or all-device claim
source: Unchanged original 3840x2160 tensile reference as a static fake 60 Hz camera
configuration: GPU reference preparation, affine16/16 B-spline, two fixed levels, median, unchanged iterations/tolerances, recording on, two CPU queue slots, 1920px preview
throughput: Computed replies and committed disk fields counted separately between main-thread monotonic snapshots
display: Worker draw and bitmap counts with their own snapshot interval; low-rate rendering must not gate computation or recording
latency: Worker arrival to disk/library admission p50/p95/p99, not sensor exposure

display_gates.maximum_rate_allowance: Requested maximum plus 2/observation_seconds for snapshot boundaries

interpretation: Publish both repeats and actual display rate. Call a gain reproduced only when both candidate committed rates exceed both 30Hz-preview baseline rates plus 2/20 fields per second. Short controls do not establish thermal statistics or 60FPS; fixed and consecutive modes must never be combined. Do not change accuracy, input size, recording, reference policy or iteration schedule to reach cadence.
